Pi Durable documentation attribution

src/skill-docs.ts embeds documentation from @earendil-works/pi-durable version
1.1.0 for offline, version-pinned agent guidance. The installed package declares
the MIT license. Its upstream copyright and license are reproduced in
PI-LICENSE.txt.

Upstream: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi
License source: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/main/LICENSE

The summary-tree implementation is independently written from the OptMem /
UniiChat design attributed to Victor Taelin:
https://gist.github.com/VictorTaelin/91837951a5ce5b38f341ec1ba1df6449

The offline evaluation preparation is inspired by TeleTune:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05437
It is not the authors' implementation and has not reproduced their results.

Other dependencies retain their own licenses. They are installed through the
pinned package lock and are not copied into the source archive.

Durable Pi interface adaptation

The browser shell, panel navigation, warm dark design, composer and optimistic
state-editor patterns are adapted from disler/durable-pi by IndyDevDan, pinned to
commit 37165c619573dbaf425463038bbffecfe576beec. The upstream MIT copyright and
license are reproduced in DURABLE-PI-LICENSE.txt.

Reviewed upstream source:
- apps/dpi-playground/apps/dpi-playground-fe/src/App.vue
- apps/dpi-playground/apps/dpi-playground-fe/src/style.css
- apps/dpi-playground/apps/dpi-playground-fe/src/components/Inspector.vue
- apps/dpi-playground/apps/dpi-playground-fe/src/components/NetworkSidebar.vue
- apps/dpi-playground/apps/dpi-playground-fe/src/components/Composer.vue

Source: https://github.com/disler/durable-pi/tree/37165c619573dbaf425463038bbffecfe576beec

This is a frontend adaptation, not a drop-in copy of the upstream runtime.
red retains its same-origin owner API, Cloudflare Durable Object state, approval
boundaries and in-memory-only browser credentials. The upstream device network,
Express hub, SQLite registry, SDK, provider credentials and persistent browser
storage are not imported. Third-party scripts were not executed.
